Subject: Payment gatekeepers & contract flow — next steps for pilot billing

Hi Katie — thanks again for the call this morning. Short recap and proposed next steps to get the pilot invoicing path confirmed so we can keep the April 10 start target: 

Summary from call:
- Pilot scope: 8 concurrent sessions, evaluation window April 10–May 10 (no production billing until pilot signoff).
- Must have PO in place and vendor intake completed before first invoice.
- Avery AP requires PO number on invoice line items and prefers ACH payment.
- Legal would like a short addendum that clarifies data handling during the pilot (non-prod, no PHI).

Open asks / next steps (owners):
1) Procurement: confirm the PO creation timeline and the exact PO field we should reference on the invoice (owner: Katie / procureops).
2) Finance: confirm preferred remit and ACH details or vendor portal link (owner: Avery AP).
3) Legal: confirm whether the short pilot addendum is acceptable or if a full SOW + MSA redline is required (owner: Samuel).
4) Redwood: share SOW v1.2 and our vendor onboarding checklist (attached). Also provide W-9 and Redwood vendor profile for intake (owner: Redwood ops).

Attachments: SOW-Redwood-AveryHealth-v1.2.pdf (draft SOW with price table), Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist.xlsx (vendor intake items we typically need).

Proposed timeline:
- 3/17: Avery confirms PO cadence and AP remit.
- 3/20: Redwood provides W-9 + vendor form filled and final SOW (if small edits).
- 3/24: Avery issues PO.
- 4/10: Pilot starts.

If those dates look tight on your side, suggest a 15-min sync Tuesday (3/18) to unblock procurement questions.

Thanks — I’ll hold a short bridge if helpful.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Tessa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from procurement / AP: 

1) PO timing: our standard timeline from intake to PO issuance is ~7 business days if we have all vendor docs and the SOW is final. Given that, 3/24 PO date is feasible but requires the completed vendor intake and W-9 by COB 3/17.

2) PO formatting: please put the PO number in the invoice "Reference" field and on each invoice line as "PO#: XXXXX". Our AP system (Coupa) also accepts invoices via vendor portal — we will confirm if Redwood is set up.

3) Remit: ACH is preferred. I will ask AP to send the exact remit template.

4) Legal: Samuel is cc'd — we need the pilot addendum language. If Redwood can provide a one-page pilot addendum that references the SOW and limits data types, legal can usually approve quickly. For now please do not share PHI or any patient-level data in the pilot (we reiterated this on the call).

Actions from our side we will do this week:
- procureops@averyhealth.com will send vendor intake form (it includes tax forms, contact info, and banking template).
- We will confirm whether Redwood needs to be added to our vendor portal or if AP will accept emailed invoices.

I’ll send the vendor intake PDF in a follow-up email (Samuel / procureops).

—Katie
Katie Barnes
Senior Procurement Manager, Avery Health

Thanks everyone. We reviewed the SOW and the high-level addendum approach looks fine. Two quick items from legal: 

1) Please add this sentence to the pilot addendum: "The parties agree that no PHI will be shared, and any personal data will be anonymized prior to ingestion for the purposes of this pilot." That should be sufficient for an expedited sign-off.

2) We will accept the single-page addendum rather than an MSA redline for the pilot, but we will need the final SOW + addendum attached to the PO request.

Katie — once you send the vendor intake form and our AP remit template I will confirm the PO target date. Jonas — if you can be on the quick call Tuesday (3/19) at 10:00am PT to walk through the invoice fields that would help.
